title: Normalized derived scalar comparison for ordinary finite Tate sources
statement:
Let $\varphi:A\to A'$ be a unital map of finite commutative rings killed by an integer $N\geq1$, and let $T$ be a scheme on which $N$ is invertible. On the small ordinary etale site, put $Q_T=(-)\otimes_A^LA'$ [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings], using the actual K-flat-normalized scalar adjunction of [lem-pur-sheaf-ring-derived-coefficient-adjunction]. Let $i_A,i_{A'}$ denote placement of module sheaves in degree zero. For a flat $A_T$-module sheaf $M$, let $q_M:Q_T(i_AM)\to i_{A'}(M\otimes_AA')$ be the scalar/single comparison defined as the derived adjoint of the ordinary scalar unit $x\mapsto x\otimes1$, with exact restriction-of-scalars/single comparison, as in [def-pur-vector-purity-scalar-single].

Then $q_M$ is the canonical isomorphism computed by the degree-zero flat resolution $M[0]$. In particular $q_{A_T}$ followed by multiplication is the normalized coefficient-unit isomorphism $u_T:Q_T(A_T[0])\xrightarrow{\sim}A'_T[0]$, with ordinary formula $a\otimes b\mapsto\varphi(a)b$.

Let $A_T(1)=\mu_{N,T}\otimes_{\mathbf Z/N}A_T$, $A_T(0)=A_T$, and $A_T(r)=A_T(1)^{\otimes_A r}$ for $r\geq1$ [lem-asd-finite-etale-twist-line]; define the primed lines similarly. For every $r\geq0$ the actual scalar/single comparison followed by the balancing map gives an isomorphism
$$l_{T,r}:Q_T(A_T(r)[2r])\xrightarrow{\sim}A'_T(r)[2r].$$
In degree zero and rank one the balancing map is $(a\otimes z)\otimes b\mapsto\varphi(a)b\otimes z$, with the root-of-unity factor written on the right using tensor symmetry. The maps for $r>0$ are its tensor powers; at $r=0$ the map is $u_T$.

For every scheme morphism $f:X\to Y$ between such schemes, every $K\in D(Y_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ and $r\geq0$, the K-flat scalar tensorator, scalar/pullback and shift comparisons [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback] followed by $l_{X,r}$ give the specified isomorphism
$$a_{f,K}:Q_X(f^*K\otimes A_X(r)[2r])\xrightarrow{\sim}f^*(Q_YK)\otimes A'_X(r)[2r].$$
At $K=A_Y[0]$ this is the same normalized unit and line comparison, and at $r=0$ it is the scalar/pullback comparison with its unitors. No flatness or finite projective dimension of $A'$ over $A$ is assumed.

proof.text: For a right-flat sheaf M, symmetry identifies left and right tensor exactness. Therefore M[0] is K-flat. Apply the K-flat representative invertibility scalarRepresentative_isIso of [lem-pur-etale-scalar-pullback-uniqueness] and the proved adjunction/single representative equality; compose with the canonical single/quotient isomorphisms. The two scalar/single maps agree by the shared definition.
Take the normalized balancing family supplied by the separate construction theorem. No data definition is formed by choosing its witness.

For two balancing families satisfying IsFiniteTateScalarBalancing of [def-pur-finite-tate-scalar-source-data], apply the ordinary scalar adjunction hom equivalence and the rank-one Tate line universal property (lineHomEquiv of [lem-asd-etale-finite-twist-pullback-rest]). Their degree-one adjuncts agree on every root generator, using the generator equation at a=b=1. Degree zero is the fixed oplax unit. Induct on the degree, using the successor tensor-power equation to conclude equality in every degree. Function extensionality and Iso.ext finish uniqueness.
